points.description: Processes the array one element at a time from left to right, treating the current position as the one being filled.

For each position, identifies the minimum (smallest) value among the remaining, unsorted elements. Equivalent wording such as 'smallest element of the rest' earns the mark. Saying the search covers the whole array, or that it finds a maximum, does not earn this mark.
Swaps that minimum with the element at the current position. Equivalent wording such as 'exchanges it into place' earns the mark.

rubric.notes: Full marks for a student who states all three ideas: left-to-right processing, finding the minimum of the remaining elements, and swapping it into the current position. Equivalent wording is accepted and the student does not need the exact model sentence. The marks are all-or-nothing per point, and a student who describes the swap but not the minimum search (or vice versa) loses that point's marks.
